title: A header and a source file
hints: The header holds the DECLARATION (prototype): `int clamp(int v, int lo, int hi);`. The `.c` file holds the DEFINITION.
Both `util.c` and `main.c` must `#include "util.h"` (with quotes, since it is your own header).
An include guard is `#ifndef UTIL_H` / `#define UTIL_H` / ... / `#endif`.
